title: Oscar Wilde goes to prison
summary: On this day in 1895, Irish poet and dramatist Oscar Wilde was convicted of “committing acts of gross indecency with certain male persons.” The charge stemmed from his relationships with young men, most notably Lord Alfred (Bosie) Douglas. Wilde served most of his two-year sentence at Reading Gaol, the subject of his final work, The Ballad of Reading Gaol (1898). In 2017 Wilde was among thousands of gay and bisexual men posthumously pardoned.
